_comment: Sample RPM artifact manifest for an explicitly patched build. Demonstrates how a CVE remediation flows through the manifest system — the new fixed build gets a new hash and a new M-of-N approval, and old vulnerable builds with their old hashes simply can never be installed by name without a manifest re-signing.
name: telnet-server-patched

metadata.note: Example of a CVE-driven artifact update. The previous build (-90.0.2) had a known vulnerable hash; this build (-90.0.3) carries the remediation. The Safebox install pipeline refuses anything not on the signed allowlist, so a Safebox still running -90.0.2 cannot accidentally install -90.0.3 without M-of-N approval — and conversely, once -90.0.3 is approved, attempts to reinstall -90.0.2 fail hash verification.
